card.name: Herbal formulas in Chinese medicine
card.fires_on: Words inside passages on traditional Chinese herbal treatment of pain, just before terms like qi, blood, kidney, stagnation or deficiency. It fires on small linking words and word parts (to, that, the, tonify) after herbs or formulas.

modes.label: Linking words after herbs
modes.description: Small words such as to, that or the right after herbal formula or herbs, before the action is stated.
modes.example: Herbal formulas are designed<< to>> dispel painful symptoms while supporting the healing

modes.label: Inside tonify and body-substance terms
modes.description: Parts of tonify or terms like kidney and blood in qi, blood and yin/yang descriptions.
modes.example: Herbal formulas that ton<<ify>> the kidney tend to be slower in action

card.writes: It pushes toward Chinese medicine vocabulary such as 中医, 中药, herbs and yin-yang.
